def verify_golomb_ruler(marks):
    """Verify that a set of marks forms a valid Golomb ruler."""
    marks = sorted(marks)
    if marks[0] != 0:
        return False, "First mark must be 0"
    
    differences = set()
    for i in range(len(marks)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(marks)):
            diff = marks[j] - marks[i]
            if diff in differences:
                return False, f"Duplicate difference: {diff}"
            differences.add(diff)
    
    return True, f"Valid Golomb ruler with {len(differences)} unique differences"
